body: Automated reviewer-role demonstration, actually performed by Zhi-Arman; not an independent student approval. Checked the combined -W -n command, bilingual conflict explanation, empty unmerged index, and tracked Markdown marker scan. These checks pass. One concrete documentation correction is requested below before confirmation.

comments.body: Please add a reproducible scan of tracked Markdown for conflict-marker lines and explain its exit codes (1 = no matches, 0 = markers found, greater than 1 = execution error). The listed diff/index checks are useful, but a clean working diff does not scan already committed content. Keep the explanation paired in Chinese and Russian.
